items.title: Kospi sell-off deepens, Why leveraged ETFs are under fire
items.summary: The KOSPI Composite Index (^KS11) rout continues, prompting South Korea's Finance Minister to apologize for introducing leveraged ETFs. Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor joins Julie Hyman on Market Domination to break down how these high-risk funds work, why they're fueling concern, and the key risks investors should understand.

items.title: Fast Money Host Warns Hyperscaler CapEx Binge Is ‘Issuing Near Junk’ as Data Center Buildout Shows Cracks
items.summary: A Fast Money host is sounding alarms that the AI buildout is quietly cracking under the weight of debt that even the bond market seems reluctant to absorb, and the ripple effects could reach far beyond Silicon Valley balance sheets.

items.title: Bank of America vs American Express: Only One Financial Stock Deserves Your Money
items.summary: Bank of America and American Express both crushed Q2 earnings, but the market rewarded only one of them while punishing the other. The gap between their stories reveals something important about where financial stocks are actually headed.

items.title: Nebius Drops 10%, CoreWeave Sinks 9% as Rising Credit-Swap Costs Hit the AI Cloud Trade
items.summary: Credit markets are quietly repricing the AI infrastructure boom, and the pain is landing hardest on a handful of heavily levered names whose borrowing costs just hit levels that historically signal serious distress.

items.title: Chip selloff overblown, UBS says, downplaying "circular financing" fears
items.summary: Semiconductors are caught in a selloff UBS thinks is overblown. The bank argues that fears over "circular financing" in AI infrastructure deals misread who's actually cashing in on the buildout, and it's the chip supply chain, not the hyperscalers, footing the bill.
